personality_one_liner: Raw, edgy, ink-inspired marketplace using high-contrast dark Brutalism to make artists and their portfolios the undisputed focal points.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, sharp containers, and thick dividers instead of soft cards. Maintain intentional whitespace imbalance.

do's: Avoid completely. Brutalism relies on solid colors, sharp borders, and high contrast.
dont's: No blur, no frosted glass, no soft overlays.

screens.name: Discover (Home)
screens.purpose: Feed of artists with search and pill-shaped style filters.

states.loading: High-contrast skeleton grid with sharp borders.
states.empty: Oversized 'NO ARTISTS FOUND' text with a reset filter button.
states.error: Signal red error block with raw typography 'CONNECTION FAILED' and a hard-edged retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal tab menu for filters (tags/pills) at the top. Below, a Pinterest-style masonry grid (or single column full-bleed images) of tattoos and artists. Images should touch edges or have thick 2pt borders. Remove heavy shadows.

screens.name: Artist Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase the artist's portfolio grid, bio, rates, and reviews.

states.loading: Blinking mono-font counter or sharp skeletons.

screens.layout: Oversized display font (Bebas Neue) for artist name overlapping a full-bleed dark hero image. A strict, border-separated grid for portfolio items. Sticky 'BOOK SESSION' CTA fixed at bottom in brandPrimary (Signal Red).

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Select date/time, add tattoo description, upload reference, and pay deposit.

states.loading: Solid screen blocking with 'PROCESSING' mono text.
states.error: Inline red validation text under form fields.

screens.layout: Mechanical, utility-focused single-column form. Labels in uppercase mono/display font above inputs. Inputs have sharp 2pt borders. Progress indicated by exposed system state (e.g., 'STEP 1 OF 3'). Bottom-sticky submit button.

screens.name: Messages

states.empty: Stark screen with 'NO MESSAGES' heading and a button to explore artists.
states.error: Simple text block 'UNABLE TO LOAD MESSAGES'.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list rows separated by 1pt/2pt solid dividers. No rounded avatars; use square profile images with high contrast.

screens.name: Bookings
screens.purpose: List of upcoming and past tattoo sessions.

states.empty: Large raw text 'NO UPCOMING SESSIONS' with a primary CTA.

screens.layout: Stacked modules with exposed metrics (Date, Time, Artist). Use borders and spacing to group data instead of floating cards. Strong numeric hierarchy for dates.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Brutalist Mobile (DARK) personality. Use a deep obsidian black background (#0A0A0A) with stark white text and a bold Signal Red (#E51C24) accent.
No rounded corners anywhere (radius is strictly 0). All buttons, images, and containers must be sharp-edged rectangles.
Do not use glassmorphism, blur, or soft shadows. Separate content using thick borders (1pt-2pt), edge-to-edge layouts, and stark color contrasts.
Leverage typography as layout. Use oversized 'Bebas Neue' for headers, making them structurally dominant, with 'DM Sans' for readability in body copy.
Ensure 'BOOK SESSION' and similar primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom of scrollable views, avoiding overlap with safe areas.
Always apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #0A0A0A) over imagery when overlaying text to maintain WCAG contrast standards.
Forms should feel mechanical: uppercase labels, thick borders on inputs, and inline solid validation colors.
For the Discover screen, implement a Pinterest-style layout or full-bleed cards separated by borders. Implement horizontal scrollable tags (pills) for filtering, but keep them sharp-edged.
